commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
bin=pathlib.Path((root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip())
fixture=root/'_fixture'
cases=[
[], ['--version'], ['--help'], ['--bogus'],
[str(fixture)], ['-a',str(fixture)], ['-A',str(fixture)],
['-1',str(fixture)], ['-l',str(fixture)], ['-la',str(fixture)],
['-T',str(fixture)], ['-Ta',str(fixture)], ['-TL','1',str(fixture)],
['--sort=name',str(fixture)], ['--sort=Name',str(fixture)], ['--sort=size',str(fixture)], ['--sort=modified',str(fixture)], ['--sort=oldest',str(fixture)], ['-r',str(fixture)],
['--group-directories-first',str(fixture)], ['--group-directories-last',str(fixture)],
['-d',str(fixture)], [str(fixture/'alpha.txt')], [str(fixture/'missing')],
]
for args in cases:
    p=subprocess.run([str(bin),*args],capture_output=True)
    print('\\n###',args,'exit',p.returncode)
    print('OUT',repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')))
    print('ERR',repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
'@ | python -"
